references.source_file: OLCB (lug_bib) Bible text — ebible mirror, Biblica cc-by-sa

note: Matthew 9:38: the father's prayer 'that God would send out labourers into the harvest' uses OLCB's own words «aweereze abakozi mu nnimiro ye» verbatim.

Zechariah 2:8: OLCB reads «anaabakwatako anaaba akutte ku mmunye ya liiso lye» (his eye, plural object); Hyde hears God say 'Mine eye' of one man, so the line is re-personed to «Amukwatako, aba akutte ku mmunye ya liiso lyange» — self_rendered, as in the es/fr/pt editions.
Revelation 12:10: OLCB has «omuloopi eyaloopanga baganda baffe»; the heading «Omuloopi wa baganda baffe» and Hyde's prayer «mbadde muloopi wa baganda bange» adapt the phrase, so self_rendered.
Quote style mirrors each English file: the long bio and short bio are curly (“ ” ’), the Q&A straight, as its English is and as 47 of 50 shipped lg Q&A files are.
